page.overview:
Who is Chass na Chadic's mother?

This female individual was the mother of Theelin Alphabet Squadron pilot Chass na Chadic. After she had left Winker's cantina on Verzan and punched a member of the Children of the Empty Sun cult, Chadic returned to her B-wing and began traveling to Troithe. During the course of the journey, Chadic thought of her mother and all the cults she had known throughout her life, hoping to have forgotten the memory of Winker's by the time she woke up.
